(a) 5 workers build a wall in 12 days: how long for 3 workers? (b) a bag of grain feeds 12 chickens for 10 days: how long for 15 chickens? (c) y = k ÷ x and y = 9 when x = 4: find y when x = 6 (d) direct, inverse or neither: x 1, 2, 3 with y 12, 6, 4; x 1, 2, 3 with y 4, 8, 12; x 1, 2, 3 with y 5, 8, 11
questions.model: (a) Total work: 5 × 12 = 60 worker-days; 3 workers: 60 ÷ 3 = 20 days. (b) 12 × 10 = 120 chicken-days; 120 ÷ 15 = 8 days.

questions.q: A water supply lasts 18 days for 30 people. After 6 days, 10 more people arrive. How much longer does it last?
y is inversely proportional to x². y = 4 when x = 3. Find y when x = 6.
In inverse proportion, when x doubles, y:
Big question: why does one quantity go down in a fixed way as the other goes up?
questions.a: The total (the product x × y) stays the same, so more of one means proportionally less of the other.
